SELECT DISTINCT
    p.entry_name AS protein_entry_name,
    p.protein_names AS protein_names
FROM proteins p
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_count
FROM proteins;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_protein_entries
FROM proteins;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.gene_name) AS distinct_gene_names_count
FROM genes g;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disease_records_with_omim
FROM disease_involvement
WHERE omim_id IS NOT NULL
  AND btrim(omim_id) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS protein_family_count
FROM protein_families;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS allergenic_property_record_count
FROM allergenic_properties;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS alanine_mutagenesis_count
FROM mutagenesis
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(original_residue, '')) <> '' 
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(mutated_residue, '')) = 'ala';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id)
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs.ligand = 'FAD';

SELECT f.description
FROM proteins p
JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308';

SELECT
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.organism,
  p.protein_names,
  p.sequence,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT f.description, '; ' ORDER BY f.description)
    FROM functions f
    WHERE f.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS functions,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT sl.location, '; ' ORDER BY sl.location)
    FROM subcellular_locations sl
    WHERE sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS subcellular_locations,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(di.disease_name, '') ||
      CASE WHEN di.omim_id IS NOT NULL AND di.omim_id <> '' THEN ' (OMIM ' || di.omim_id || ')' ELSE '' END ||
      CASE WHEN di.description IS NOT NULL AND di.description <> '' THEN ': ' || di.description ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY di.disease_name
    )
    FROM disease_involvement di
    WHERE di.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS disease_involvement,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT bu.description, '; ' ORDER BY bu.description)
    FROM biotechnological_uses bu
    WHERE bu.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS biotechnological_uses,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pu.description, '; ' ORDER BY pu.description)
    FROM pharmaceutical_uses pu
    WHERE pu.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS pharmaceutical_uses,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT td.dose_description ||
      CASE WHEN td.measurement_unit IS NOT NULL AND td.measurement_unit <> '' THEN ' ' || td.measurement_unit ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY td.dose_description
    )
    FROM toxic_doses td
    WHERE td.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS toxic_doses,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT ap.description, '; ' ORDER BY ap.description)
    FROM allergenic_properties ap
    WHERE ap.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS allergenic_properties,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT i.interacting_protein ||
      CASE WHEN i.interaction_type IS NOT NULL AND i.interaction_type <> '' THEN ' (' || i.interaction_type || ')' ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY i.interacting_protein
    )
    FROM interactions i
    WHERE i.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS interactions,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT tl.lineage_path, ' > ' ORDER BY tl.rank_order)
    FROM taxonomic_lineage tl
    WHERE tl.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS taxonomic_lineage,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(asite.description, '') ||
      CASE WHEN asite.position IS NOT NULL AND asite.position <> '' THEN ' (pos ' || asite.position || ')' ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY asite.position
    )
    FROM active_sites asite
    WHERE asite.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS active_sites,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(bs.description, '') ||
      CASE WHEN bs.start_position IS NOT NULL OR bs.end_position IS NOT NULL
        THEN ' [' || COALESCE(bs.start_position::text, '') || '-' || COALESCE(bs.end_position::text, '') || ']'
        ELSE ''
      END ||
      CASE WHEN bs.ligand IS NOT NULL AND bs.ligand <> '' THEN ' ligand: ' || bs.ligand ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY bs.start_position, bs.end_position
    )
    FROM binding_sites bs
    WHERE bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS binding_sites,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(m.position_start::text, '') || CASE WHEN m.position_end IS NOT NULL THEN '-' || m.position_end::text ELSE '' END || ': ' ||
      COALESCE(m.original_residue, '') || ' -> ' || COALESCE(m.mutated_residue, '') ||
      CASE WHEN m.effect IS NOT NULL AND m.effect <> '' THEN ' (' || m.effect || ')' ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY m.position_start
    )
    FROM mutagenesis m
    WHERE m.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS mutagenesis,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(td.domain_name, '') ||
      CASE WHEN td.start_position IS NOT NULL OR td.end_position IS NOT NULL
        THEN ' [' || COALESCE(td.start_position::text, '') || '-' || COALESCE(td.end_position::text, '') || ']'
        ELSE ''
      END ||
      CASE WHEN td.description IS NOT NULL AND td.description <> '' THEN ': ' || td.description ELSE '' END,
      '; ' ORDER BY td.start_position
    )
    FROM topological_domains td
    WHERE td.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS topological_domains,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT g.gene_name, '; ' ORDER BY g.gene_name)
    FROM protein_genes pg
    JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
    WHERE pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS genes,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pw.pathway_name, '; ' ORDER BY pw.pathway_name)
    FROM protein_pathways pp
    JOIN pathways pw ON pw.pathway_id = pp.pathway_id
    WHERE pp.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS pathways,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pf.family_name, '; ' ORDER BY pf.family_name)
    FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
    JOIN protein_families pf ON pf.family_id = pfm.family_id
    WHERE pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
  ), '') AS protein_families,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM proteins p
WHERE p.entry = 'P01308';

    WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'

SELECT

  ON tl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'

FROM (
  SELECT 1
  FROM interactions
  GROUP BY protein_id, interacting_protein, interaction_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
) AS x;

SELECT

  p.entry_name,
  td.dose_description,
  td.measurement_unit
FROM proteins p
JOIN toxic_doses td
  ON td.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'

SELECT DISTINCT p.entry
FROM proteins p
JOIN biotechnological_uses btu ON btu.protein_id = p.protein_id
ORDER BY p.entry;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS distinct_disease_associated_proteins_with_atp_binding_site
FROM proteins p
JOIN disease_involvement di ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs.ligand ILIKE '%ATP%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS proteins_with_disease
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm
  ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN protein_families f
  ON f.family_id = pfm.family_id
JOIN disease_involvement d
  ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.family_name ILIKE '%protein kinase superfamily%';

SELECT
    pfam.family_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT di.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM protein_family_memberships pfm
JOIN protein_families pfam
    ON pfam.family_id = pfm.family_id
JOIN disease_involvement di
    ON di.protein_id = pfm.protein_id
GROUP BY pfam.family_name
ORDER BY protein_count DESC, pfam.family_name
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(p.sequence)))::integer AS avg_sequence_length
FROM proteins p
JOIN binding_sites bs
  ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE bs.ligand ILIKE '%Zn(2+)%' OR bs.ligand ILIKE '%Zn%2+%' OR bs.ligand ILIKE '%Zn2+%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN subcellular_locations l
  ON l.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN disease_involvement d
  ON d.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE l.location = 'Cell membrane';

SELECT
  p.entry AS accession,
  COUNT(i.interaction_id) AS interaction_count
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_family_memberships pfm
  ON pfm.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN protein_families f
  ON f.family_id = pfm.family_id
JOIN interactions i
  ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE f.family_name = 'protein kinase superfamily'
GROUP BY p.entry
ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, accession
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    bs.ligand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bs.protein_id) AS distinct_protein_count
FROM binding_sites bs
WHERE bs.ligand IS NOT NULL AND bs.ligand <> ''
GROUP BY bs.ligand
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT bs.protein_id) DESC, bs.ligand
LIMIT 3;

SELECT pdb.pdb_structure_id
FROM proteins p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT (regexp_match(
           concat_ws(
             ' ',
             p.protein_names,
             f.description,
             sl.location,
             di.disease_name,
             di.description,
             di.omim_id,
             btu.description,
             pu.description,
             td.dose_description,
             td.measurement_unit,
             ap.description,
             i.interaction_type,
             ai.interacting_protein,
             tl.lineage_path,
             ast.description,
             ast.position,
             bs.ligand,
             bs.description,
             ms.original_residue,
             ms.mutated_residue,
             ms.description,
             ms.effect,
             tds.domain_name,
             tds.description
           ),
           '(?i)\\b([0-9][a-z0-9]{3})\\b'
         ))[1] AS pdb_structure_id
  FROM functions f
  LEFT JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN disease_involvement di ON di.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN biotechnological_uses btu ON btu.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN pharmaceutical_uses pu ON pu.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN toxic_doses td ON td.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN allergenic_properties ap ON ap.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN interactions ai ON ai.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN taxonomic_lineage tl ON tl.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN active_sites ast ON ast.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN binding_sites bs ON bs.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN mutagenesis ms ON ms.protein_id = p.protein_id
  LEFT JOIN topological_domains tds ON tds.protein_id = p.protein_id
  WHERE p.entry = 'P04637'
  LIMIT 1
) pdb;

SELECT DISTINCT sl.location AS tissues_expressed_in
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
JOIN subcellular_locations sl ON sl.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE g.gene_name = 'BRCA1'
ORDER BY tissues_expressed_in;

SELECT DISTINCT f.description AS go_term
FROM proteins p
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.protein_id = p.protein_id
JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = pg.gene_id
JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE g.gene_name ILIKE '%insulin%';

SELECT
  'TP53' AS gene_name,
  NULL::text AS chromosome
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM genes g
  WHERE g.gene_name = 'TP53'
);

SELECT
  p.protein_id,
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.organism
FROM proteins p;

SELECT
  g.gene_name,
  COUNT(pg.protein_id) AS protein_count
FROM genes g
JOIN protein_genes pg ON pg.gene_id = g.gene_id
GROUP BY g.gene_name
ORDER BY protein_count DESC, g.gene_name;

SELECT protein_id, entry, entry_name, organism
FROM proteins
ORDER BY protein_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.entry,
       p.entry_name,
       f.description
FROM proteins p
JOIN functions f ON f.protein_id = p.protein_id
WHERE p.entry = 'P04637';

SELECT
  p.protein_id,
  p.entry,
  p.entry_name,
  p.organism,
  p.protein_names,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM proteins p
WHERE p.entry = 'X00000' OR p.entry_name = 'TEST_HUMAN';
SELECT pg_sleep(60), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proteins) AS protein_count;
SELECT * FROM proteins;

SELECT
  interaction_id,
  protein_id,
  interacting_protein,
  interaction_type
FROM interactions
ORDER BY interaction_id;
